name: Dark Temple, Healing Room
desc1: These tall-ceilinged chamber's walls appear to be crafted from black
desc2: marble. Columns holding up the roof are carved with many demonic
desc3: beings and large contorted skulls. The floor is patterened with dark
desc4: grey and red stone, and is smooth and polished. Flat-topped slabs of
desc5: marble serve as beds here for people to be healed, and a small table
desc6: up against the wall holds vaguely unsettling surgery instruments. The
desc7: hallway to the east leads into the entrance chamber of the Temple.
